testHarness.core-cold.sh:
set -euo pipefail
export AUTORAG_EMBED_ENDPOINT=http://127.0.0.1:18382
export AUTORAG_WORKSPACE=/qa-state/fixed-workspace
export AUTORAG_SEARCH_PATHS=/workspace/scripts/live-e2e/corpus
export AUTORAG_MEMORY_PATH=/qa-state/fixed-memory.json
export AUTORAG_LIVE_E2E_KIWI=required
test "$AUTORAG_CONFIG" = /dev-home/.autorag/config.json
node scripts/live-e2e/runner.mjs verify-corpus --root /workspace/scripts/live-e2e
node scripts/live-e2e/runner.mjs preflight --endpoint "$AUTORAG_EMBED_ENDPOINT" --json > /qa-evidence/preflight.json
bun scripts/live-e2e/live-stack.mts --root /workspace/scripts/live-e2e --workspace "$AUTORAG_WORKSPACE" --mode cold
cp "$AUTORAG_WORKSPACE/live-stack-result.json" /qa-evidence/fixed-core-cold.json

export AUTORAG_QA_TOKENIZER=/dev-home/.autorag/models/fastembed/qwen3-0.6b-af95f2c416ffe9379369ad64f9113e865db6112c

set -euo pipefail
mkdir -p "$AUTORAG_HOME"
test "$AUTORAG_CONFIG" = /tmp/autorag-qa-home/.autorag/config.json
bun run check
bun run lint
bun run typecheck
/opt/autorag-embedding/bin/python -m unittest discover -s test/embedding -p '*_test.py'
bun run supply-chain
node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --maxWorkers=2 > /qa-evidence/full-tests.log 2>&1
